{{Top|leg|notoc=1}}
The '''Mon Calamari Civil Authority''' was a group who had a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] out on the [[Draag]] criminal [[Slaag Lado]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]]. The group wanted Lado for allegedly creating a huge seismic attack that led to immense environmental damage in the [[Salinrerian Sea]] and resulted in constant rain on the site. In the bounty posted for Lado, the Civil Authority noted the Draag's ties to another group, known as the [[Calamasthon Defiance]].<ref name="BH" /> It is unknown if the group was connected with the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dac/Legends|Dac]].

==Behind the scenes==
The video game ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]'', released by [[LucasArts]] in [[2002]], mentions the Mon Calamari Civil Authority in its bounty information for Slaag Lado, a character who appears in the game's second level.<ref name="BH">''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter]]''.</ref> The information from Lado's entry is repeated in ''[[Star Wars: Bounty Hunter: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'', published in 2002, and in ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', published in [[2008]].<ref name="CSWE II 240">{{CSWECite|II|240}}.</ref>
